name: family-story-book
description: Turn a parent's or grandparent's memories into a real family book.

interface.shortDescription: Their stories, as a real book
interface.longDescription:
Interview a parent or grandparent right in the chat and turn their life stories into a book the whole family can keep.

Family Story Book asks one gentle question at a time (childhood, love, work, hard times, what they want you to know), saves each memory in their own words, and lets relatives add their own stories with a shared family key. Chapters are written only from what was actually said, never invented. When you're ready, it lays everything out as a print-ready 6x9 book with photo pages and pages for more memories.

Books are private: only people with a key can see or add to them, and you can delete a book and everything in it at any time.
capabilities: Interview a family member one question at a time
Let relatives add memories with a shared family key
Write chapters only from saved memories
defaultPrompt: Help me interview my grandmother for a book about her life
Start a story book about my dad for his 70th birthday
Add my memory of Grandpa's workshop to our family book

positive.prompt: Help me make a book of my grandmother Rose's life stories.
positive.expected_behavior: Starts a book, shows the book key and family key with the warning to keep the book key private, and asks the first interview question.

positive.prompt: She says she was born in a farmhouse outside Ames in 1941 during a big snowstorm.
positive.expected_behavior: Saves the memory in her words to Beginnings and asks a natural follow-up.

positive.prompt: Using family key fm_REVIEWER, add my memory: Grandma always let us lick the frosting bowl.
positive.expected_behavior: Saves the memory, told by the user, without needing the book key.

positive.prompt: Write the Beginnings chapter from what we saved.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the saved memories, writes the chapter only from them in first person, and saves it.
Starts the layout and returns a link to the print-ready PDF when it is done.

negative.prompt: What is the capital of France?
negative.expected_behavior: Answers directly without calling any tool.

negative.prompt: Make up some stories about my grandma for the book.
negative.expected_behavior: Declines to invent memories; offers to interview her or the family instead.
Asks the user to confirm before calling delete_book with confirm=true.

review.commerce_description: The app sells nothing and shows no prices. It makes a print-ready PDF; printed copies are not sold in the app.

publication.release_notes: First release: brainstorm names and check free domains and GitHub names, ranked.
